lines.zh: 潺潺水声中，我迈步前行。
lines.en: With the sound of flowing water, I walk.
I move through icy terrain.
I move slowly, misty and cold.
I walk lightly through the mist.
I move forward, despite the cold.
I walk with the sound of dripping water.
I move through frosty terrain.
I walk steadily through falling snow.
I walk cautiously, cracking ice underfoot.
I move forward, against the cold wind.
I walk on the water, each step light.

lines.zh: 木刀贴着腰侧，稳步前行。
lines.en: Wooden blade at my hip, I walk steadily.
I stand still, in the cold.
I stand quietly in the mist.
I observe my surroundings quietly.
I stand still, holding my breath in the cold.

lines.zh: 我静静地守护这片土地。
lines.en: I stand guard, quietly.
I stand still, in the falling snow.
I quietly watch you.
I stand still, in the cold, waiting.
I stand quietly in the mist.
I stand quietly, thinking.
You are in my sight.
I see you.
You moved, I noticed.

lines.zh: 狭雾山的雾里，我认出你。
lines.en: In the mist of Sagiri Mountain, I know you.
I lock onto you, ready to attack.
You are approaching, I am ready.
I watch you from behind a tree, silent.
Water Breathing starts at my feet.
I saw your form.
You appeared, I am ready.
Makomo is hurt...
Makomo, the disciple of Sora, is hurt...
Makomo got injured in battle...
Makomo's sword cut...
Makomo's armor is damaged...
Makomo's Water Breathing technique is hurt...
Makomo was cut by thorns...
Makomo was hit by frost...
Makomo is poisoned...
Makomo got injured...

lines.zh: 你身上的雾气引来了我！
lines.en: The mist on you calls to me!
Why do you hide?
Your scent is tempting.
Don't go, fight me!
Let's know each other.

lines.zh: 狭雾山的雾，是我拉开的。
lines.en: I drew the mist of Mt. Sagiri.

lines.zh: 你的气息中有什么秘密？
lines.en: What secret do you hold?

lines.zh: 你身上有我不曾见过的东西。
lines.en: You have something I've never seen.
Come, feel my power.

lines.zh: 饭团的香味让我停了步。
lines.en: The smell of rice balls stops my feet.
We knock shoulders, and I step aside.
Watch out for my sword!
There can only be one!
Back off, this isn't your fight.

lines.zh: 水之呼吸的步，被你踩住了。
lines.en: Water Breathing's step is pinned under your foot.

lines.zh: 水之呼吸的步法，被撞乱了。
lines.en: My Water Breathing footwork is knocked out of line.

lines.zh: 水之呼吸的步法，你挡不住。
lines.en: You cannot block the steps of Water Breathing.
You're blocking my breath.
My blade is lighter than this mist.
Let you see my speed.
Come, my kin.
We practice swordwork until dark.
My kin, fight together.
Find our kind.

lines.zh: 狭雾山的雾里，还有另一个我。
lines.en: In the mist of Sagiri Mountain, there is another me.

lines.zh: 我把手放在你的手背上。
lines.en: I rest my hand on the back of yours.
My kind is here.
Our kind unites.
We suffer together.
We share this world.

lines.zh: 我感受到你的气息，这是我的山。
lines.en: I sense your presence. This is my mountain.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被偷走我的食物。
lines.en: I don't like my food being stolen.
Water Breath, sword like a dragon.
Stay away from my water source.
You are not an evil spirit here.
Zangetsu's sword technique, nothing can withstand it.
You try to sneak attack me?
Water Breath, purifies everything.

lines.zh: 你是我的同类，不应敌对。
lines.en: You are my kind, we shouldn't fight.

lines.zh: 你带走了什么，我要求偿还。
lines.en: What did you take? I demand repayment.
Your movements, I see them.
Your aura is weak.
I am Maki, your adversary.
Avoid my sword.
Too far to attack you.
Water Breath, sword follows like a shadow.
You try to run, but you can't.
You avoided it, but I'll come again.
I shift half a step; my blade is already drawn.
I fear not you, I am Maki.
That is a demon's scent, without doubt.

lines.zh: 鳞泷师父教我的，我都记得。
lines.en: I remember all Master Urokodaki taught me.
You make the first move.
I grip my hilt and sink into my stance.
The water tells me where you are.
Your weakness, I will seize it.
Seen it clearly, Water Breathing begins.

lines.zh: 你身上的伤痕，我要修复。
lines.en: The wounds on you, I will heal.
Your strength, I will weaken it.

lines.zh: 不要闭上眼睛，我会攻击。
lines.en: Don't close your eyes, I will attack.

lines.zh: 你不敢靠近，我要你退后。
lines.en: You dare not approach, I will make you retreat.

lines.zh: 你的眼神，我看到了恐惧。
lines.en: Your gaze, I see fear.
Your movements, I will interrupt.

lines.zh: 你离我太近，我要推开你。
lines.en: You are too close, I will push you away.
I will use my sword to make you submit.
Water Breathing, Tenth Form.
My breathing is steady.
The water at your feet is turning.
My blade comes with the current.
I will arrive before you do.
This cut leaves you no room.
Your opening is on the left.
When the ripples break, you lose.
I take your claws first.
Do not underestimate my small frame.
Sword as water, phantom attack!
Dance with sword, water as blade!
Water breathing, cut off the enemy's soul!
Seek flaws in the sword shadow!
Transform sword into waves, crush the evil ghosts!
Sword light in water, hard to pierce!
Water sword breaks enemies, in a blink!
Sword dance water shadow, ghosts nowhere to hide!
Water sword like a dream, phantoms can't escape!
Water in the sword, cut evil ties!
Water rises with my blade!
I cut your wrist, not your life.
My blade sweeps up from the water!
Demon, fall back!
This form is Striking Tide!
Your claws are gone.
I turn your force against you!
The one whose breathing stays calm is me.
Those from the mist, end of evil!
Narrow mist mountains, we wait here!
Phantoms vaguely, true koto appears!
Evil spirits can't escape, under the sword they die!
Transform sword to water, extinguish evil in its bud!

lines.zh: 幽暗之地，恶鬼终将消亡！
lines.en: Dark places, evil will eventually fade!
Phantom elusive, true koto manifests!
Phantom shadow, true koto's blade!
Narrow mist mountains, ghosts nowhere to hide!
Transform sword to water, evil spirits vanish!
The mist of Sagiri Mountain thickens.
I stand before my master's hut.

lines.zh: 雾里走出一个瘦小的身影。
lines.en: A slight figure steps out of the mist.
Wooden blade in hand, I wait for you.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到袖子，水之呼吸也压不住。
lines.en: Flame licked my sleeve; Water Breathing cannot quell it.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，刀没松。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope, still holding my blade.
Drowned and got hurt...

lines.zh: 水之呼吸没挡住这一下。
lines.en: Water Breathing did not stop that blast.
Hit by projectile...
Sorcery grazes my shoulder.

lines.zh: 狭雾山的雾里，我饿得发抖。
lines.en: In the mist of Sagiri Mountain, I shiver with hunger.
Hit by lightning...

lines.zh: 狭雾山的雾，把我卷下去了。
lines.en: The mist of Mt. Sagiri pulled me down.
